context_for_next_testing_agent: FlowForge Phase 1 MVP is complete and working. Key components: FlowForgeFAB.jsx (floating action button), UnitSelectionModal.jsx (unit picker), FlowForgeChat.jsx (chat interface), BuildHistory.jsx (conversation history). Backend uses Supabase for data persistence (flowforge_conversations, flowforge_messages tables) and Claude via Emergent LLM for AI responses. The /api/flowforge/generate endpoint can take 5-15 seconds for AI responses.
